A readable Substack note from @pancooke presents a comic about AI art and what might be lost. The fetched text exposes its caption and engagement interface, but not enough of the comic itself to analyze its argument or visual storytelling.

No claim about the panels, depicted people, artistic technique or precise conclusion can be grounded from that caption alone. The displayed relative age and calendar date also do not supply a reliable new event date without further checking. Popularity counters are not evidence that the comic's position is correct. No image interpretation, reproduction or subscription was performed.
highlights: Coverage is limited to the note caption
Comic panels were not visually inspected
Detailed argument and conclusion remain unknown
Date presentation is not relied on as a new event
No account or subscription action occurred
